features.name: Anonymous Session Flood
features.description: docs/plan/anonymous-session-flood-plan.md: every request without a cookie to a session_web group writes a 24h anonymous session (+ refresh marker) to Redis, even when the route answers 401 — Redis memory DoS vector and the cause of 'Redis unavailable' under load. A: create the anonymous session lazily (only when it is needed: CSRF bootstrap, session data, login); B: SESSION_ANON_TTL (2h, sliding) for anonymous sessions; load proof: 0 Redis keys per anonymous request to an auth_guard route

features.evidence: PR #192 (merge 5837fdb): progress.md Evidence of Completion — typecheck/lint/format, test (backend 1200, frontend 168, api-playground 14, shared 14, docs 26), test:pg 45 with Redis / 37 without (+8 session-revocation on real PostgreSQL and Redis: cleanup failure -> first request after recovery already 401, concurrent change-password -> one winner, database down -> 503, deleted user; 4 of 8 fail with the token check neutralised), test:redis 61, docs:build + docs:verify, test:e2e:security 7 on the real prod server; CI quality/e2e/build/test-pg/test-redis green (test-pg ran all 45, none skipped); cost p50 0.10 -> 0.37 ms per sessionHandler on local PostgreSQL Review follow-up (branch fix/feat-059-review-followups): lookup deadline SESSION_TOKEN_CHECK_TIMEOUT_MS (default 2000 ms; a hung query -> 503), the HTTP contract proved over a real server with real session_web/csrf_guard/auth_guard on PostgreSQL+Redis (8 tests, incl. concurrent change-password and the reset flow with a failing Redis cleanup; 5 of 8 fail with the token check neutralised), plan phase B synced; test:pg 53 with Redis / 37 without, backend 1223. Second follow-up (branch fix/session-check-query-cancel): the lookup is cancelled, not abandoned — dedicated session-check pool with statement_timeout (server cancels, 57014) and query_timeout (stalled server, connection destroyed, slot freed); proved on real PostgreSQL with a table lock and a stalling proxy (5 tests; without statement_timeout 2 fail, without query_timeout 1 fails); backend 1232, test:pg 58 with Redis / 42 without, test:redis 61, test:e2e:security 7. Simplification (branch chore/simplify-session-check-timeouts): the application-level Promise.race and the SESSION_TOKEN_CHECK_POOL_MAX variable removed — the pool timeouts alone give the bound (all real-PostgreSQL tests pass without the race), the pool size is a constant; the hanging-lookup HTTP test now uses a real table lock.
